title: Development of a machine learning-based treatment-response prediction model for levetiracetam in pediatric epilepsy: integrating ABCB1 polymorphism and therapeutic drug monitoring.
what: Empirical dosing of levetiracetam (LEV) in pediatric epilepsy often yields variable outcomes. This study aimed to develop a machine learning-based treatment-response prediction model integrating therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) and ABCB1 C3435 T polymorphism.
why: The study found that LEV trough concentration and ABCB1 genotype are the strongest associative factors for clinical outcomes.
pkpd_hook: The XGBoost model demonstrated a high predictive performance, with LEV trough concentration as a key factor.
original_title: Development of a machine learning-based treatment-response prediction model for levetiracetam in pediatric epilepsy: integrating ABCB1 polymorphism and therapeutic drug monitoring.
headline: Machine learning model predicts levetiracetam response in pediatric epilepsy

title: Attainment of Prophylactic Target Posaconazole Concentrations During Admission for Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplant.
what: Invasive fungal infections (IFIs) contribute to morbidity and mortality following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT). Posaconazole is oftentimes utilized for antifungal prophylaxis due to its broad-spectrum activity against yeast and mold.
why: 32.4% of patients achieved initial prophylactic target trough concentration, while 67.6% had concentrations below target.
pkpd_hook: Median time to target attainment was 16 days (IQR, 7-20 days)
original_title: Attainment of Prophylactic Target Posaconazole Concentrations During Admission for Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplant.
headline: Prophylactic Posaconazole Concentrations in Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplant patients

title: Efficacy and Safety of Benralizumab in Moderate to Very Severe Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) With a History of Frequent Exacerbations
what: Phase 3 study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of a benralizumab in patients with moderate to very severe COPD with a history of frequent COPD exacerbations and elevated peripheral blood eosinophils (≥300/μL). Eligible patients must have a history of ≥2 moderate and/or severe COPD exacerbations in the previous year despite receiving triple (ICS/LABA/LAMA) background therapy for at least 3 months and ICS-based dual inhaled treatment for the remainder of the year.
why: Study evaluates benralizumab's effectiveness and safety for moderate to severe COPD patients with frequent exacerbations and high eosinophil count.
pkpd_hook: Study duration varies, primary endpoint analyzed at Week 56.
original_title: Efficacy and Safety of Benralizumab in Moderate to Very Severe Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) With a History of Frequent Exacerbations
headline: Benralizumab efficacy & Safety in Frequent COPD exacerbators
